etymologies.etymologyHTML: From child +‎ -like.

definitions.definition: Of, like, or suitable for a child.

quote.citation: 2019 May 8, Jon Bailes, “Save yourself! The video games casting us as helpless children”, in The Guardian‎[1]:
quote.text: Even Mario is given childlike mannerisms – running open-armed like a fearless toddler, whooping with delight – to convey playful innocence.
